learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to understand the chemical composition of cast irons, their microstructure, and their effects on cast iron properties.
Students will be able to understand iron-iron carbide and iron-graphite systems.

Students will be able to understand the effect of cooling rate, section thickness, and alloying elements on the microstructure of gray cast iron, and the inoculation and heat treatment of gray cast iron.
Students will be able to understand the metallurgy, solidification, mechanical properties, physical properties, and heat treatments of steel castings.
Students will be able to understand the phase diagrams and properties of non-ferrous alloys, aluminum casting alloys, grain refinement, modification, and heat treatment of aluminum alloys.

syllabus_topics: Chemical compositions, microstructures, graphite types and effects on properties of cast iron
Effect of cooling rate and section thickness on microstructure in gray cast irons
Inoculation and heat treatment of cast irons
Metallurgy of steel casting. Solidification of steel castings
Physical properties and heat treatments of steel castings
Introduction to non-ferrous alloys. Phase diagrams of non-ferrous alloys
Introduction to non-ferrous alloys. Phase diagrams of non-ferrous alloys
Classification of aluminum and its alloys. Cast aluminum alloys, structure control, modification, grain refinement, heat treatment
Classification of copper casting alloys. Alloying elements in copper alloys
Casting methods of copper and its alloys. Microstructure control and gases in copper alloys
Mg and Zn alloys. Casting methods of Mg and Zinc alloys
bibliography: Ergin N. Çavusoglu, Döküm Teknolojisi, İTÜ Matbaası, 1981
